identity.name: Kamasu
identity.one_liner: The sub-$250 automatic dive watch with sapphire crystal, 200m water resistance, and hacking — the most-recommended entry diver in Southeast Asia.

narrative.story: The Kamasu (Japanese for barracuda) pairs Orient's in-house F6724 automatic with a sapphire crystal and 200m water resistance at a price that undercuts Seiko and Citizen by a wide margin. Orient sells it in Asia under the Mako III name; the Kamasu designation is the one most collectors cite. It is the most-recommended sub-$300 automatic dive watch in the SEA market and the watch a first-time buyer lands on before graduating to a Seiko Prospex or a Tudor Black Bay.
narrative.collector_notes: The Kamasu and the Mako III share the same F6724 movement and case; the naming varies by market. Sapphire crystal and a solid end-link bracelet distinguish it from the older Mako II.
